sentence: This project studies how intense wildfires change the water chemistry and the bacteria and archaea living in volcanic caves.
This project builds models of how plasma turbulence heats the corona and the solar wind.
This project tries to find out how much carbon is in the upper mantle, using experiments on silicate melts and melt inclusions.
This project holds a conference that brings together statisticians, computer scientists and domain scientists to work on statistics and artificial intelligence.
This project builds algorithms that process large datasets quickly and keep scientists from being overconfident in their conclusions.
This project creates datasets of control-plane behavior and attacks in cellular networks, so that researchers can study security threats.
This project builds an open resource that helps researchers find, compare and use underground models for earthquake science.
This project trains a deep neural network to learn how switch settings in metamaterials change the radiation patterns of phased arrays.
This project develops a robotic glove that helps people recovering from stroke move their fingers, using the movement of the unimpaired hand.
This project uses strain to tune unconventional and topological superconductors, to find out why their electrons pair.
This project tries to find out whether the chromatin state can lock genes at many expression levels rather than only on or off.
This project studies how energetic electrons get trapped and accelerated in magnetized plasma with magnetic islands and chaotic magnetic fields.
This project studies how heated polymeric waste turns into either hazardous polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons or useful small molecules.
